description:
Tests that do not check what their names state: `test_cached_neighbors_correctness` in `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/core.rs` compares `row_iter` with itself; `test_with_lane_canonicalises` in `crates/gf2-algebra/src/packed/bipedal3.rs` starts from a lane that is already canonical, so it never overwrites an alternate-zero lane.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each named test asserts the property in its name against an independent reference, and fails when that property is broken (shown by a temporary mutation recorded in the commit message).
title: Vacuous and misnamed tests found by the comment sweep
